sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details a confirmed card-not-present fraud incident involving customer C08226 and card C08226-K1. On December 1, 2016, between 07:06:50 and 07:23:55, three unauthorized online transactions were attempted in billing region 330. The activity was initiated using a specific device profile identified as Windows | Windows 10 | edge 15.0 | 1365x768. This activity is highly suspicious because this rare device profile was recently used by three other customers and connected to another card, C12690-K2, suggesting a coordinated fraud effort or ring. Furthermore, the transaction model scored the initial transaction at 0.832 for fraud, and the customer account already had a history of confirmed fraud from October 2016 in closed case CC-5528. The total exposure for this specific card episode is $29.83, while the broader device-linked fraudulent activity totals $59.82. Due to the clear indicators of unauthorized use and cross-account device sharing, the bank has blocked the card and is monitoring connected accounts.
